messages.subject: Problem with including data in package
parts:
I've been using Rstudio and devtools with Roxygen to build a project for a while (at least two years) and after updating Rstudio to version 0.98.1074 two days ago, the data are not loaded, they are not included no matter I include them in the /data folder or in the inst/extdata folder.
Any suggestions?
Thanks very much in advance

messages.author: 05e6adbbadfe0364
messages.subject: Re: Problem with including data in package
parts:
Hi Hadley,
The problem has been solved, it was due to the data file having .Rdata instead of .RData extension. Quite simple and obvious, but not until you know the sensitiveness of R with capitals reaches the extensions in the system. Kevin Ushey from Rstudio gave me the hint, so just to let you know it has been solved and you do not have to lose any time with such a trifle (now that I know).
Best and thanks anyway.
Fran
